package.description: iOS code signing and inspection tool

en-US.description: iOS code signing and inspection tool
en-US.longDescription:
plumesign is the command-line interface of Impactor (formerly PlumeImpactor).
It signs iOS app bundles with a certificate and provisioning profile, inspects Mach-O binaries, manages Apple Developer account authentication and manages connected devices.
en-US.name: Impactor CLI
